title: Measurement Conversion Worksheets: Larger Units
intro: Explain why a larger unit requires a smaller count for the same measurement.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Compare the given unit sizes before converting. Use a concrete example to show the measured quantity staying fixed.

Ask your student

How many of the smaller units fit in one larger unit?

If your student needs help

If the answer grows when it should shrink, return to the unit relationship and estimate its size.

Choosing and using the worksheet

Each set has one question for each of the four unit pairs. The original problems have whole-number answers from 2 to 9. They do not include decimal answers such as 5 cm = 0.05 m, mixed units, or multi-step stories.
